from_speaker: Any price increases by OpenAI or Anthropic

our_interpretation: The antecedent is an announced increase in the price of a service or its successor offering. An additional premium tier alone need not qualify.
The plain reading is that a qualifying increase indicates investor dissatisfaction with the economics of providing the service, rather than merely a wish to earn more revenue.
No deadline or accounting definition of unit economics is supplied.
Because the statement says any price increases, a successor-model repricing is included; that scope choice is material.
criteria.support_condition: A qualifying price increase occurs, and reliable evidence connects it to investors finding the existing service economics unacceptable.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A qualifying increase occurs, and reliable evidence establishes that investors accepted the existing economics and that the increase was unrelated to the claimed dissatisfaction.
